title: The Songbook of Port Alder
author: Isandro Thornbury
blurb: Cyrus Brightwater, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
